purpose: Convert three filed economy negatives into boundary cases of measured frontier laws (global-recovery doctrine satisfied by definition/mechanic change; all costs charged; no outcome tuning).

D29_crossover_frontier.machinery: research/hsg-semantic-execution-v1/exact/run_rv_b1.py UNCHANGED except the query-stream generator gains a frozen rho dial (novel-region fraction of the query stream)
D29_crossover_frontier.worlds: the 30 frozen RV_B1 worlds, seeds unchanged; ONLY the query stream composition varies (swap the reader, never the metric)
D29_crossover_frontier.primary_endpoint: Q*(rho) = smallest Q at which abstraction total cost < direct total cost, per rho; NULL if no crossing within the grid
D29_crossover_frontier.registered_prediction: Q*(rho) finite iff rho < rho* in [0.51, 0.905] (two derivations in NEGATIVES_ROOT_CAUSE_V1 section 3.2); monotone non-decreasing in rho; rho=1.0 reproduces the filed negative (crossover_Q null) as the boundary
D29_crossover_frontier.falsifier: no finite Q*(rho) anywhere off the rho=1 axis, OR Q* non-monotone in rho — then the capital-cost-floor law as stated is wrong and must be replaced
terminals: NO_CROSSOFF_ANYWHERE_OFF_RHO1 (falsifies the frontier form; RC2 restated)

D30_delta_dial.machinery: the frozen D20 runner with a frozen delta dial on the abstract answer (delta-relaxed block answering: an answer may be served from the abstraction when the certified error bound <= delta; delta=0 is the frozen exact path)
D30_delta_dial.worlds: the 30 frozen D20 worlds, seeds unchanged
D30_delta_dial.primary_endpoint: total_cost(delta) vs total_cost_direct(n) per (delta, n); the (delta, compression, cost) Pareto frontier
D30_delta_dial.registered_prediction: delta=0 reproduces the filed negative everywhere (boundary of the family); some delta in (0, 0.25] beats direct on total cost at n in the upper grid half
D30_delta_dial.falsifier: no delta in (0,1) at which structural capital strictly beats direct on total cost at ANY grid point — then the self-defeat law extends to the relaxed regime and the admissible claim shape narrows to rho-conditioned only

D31_episodic_depth_law.machinery: the frozen D19 substitution machinery with a frozen recompute-depth dial on the query family (solution depth d of the recomputation the substitution would replace)
D31_episodic_depth_law.worlds: the frozen D19 worlds, seeds unchanged
D31_episodic_depth_law.registered_prediction: ratio is monotone non-increasing in d and crosses 1 at finite d* (D19's 1.07 at d=1 is the shallow boundary)
D31_episodic_depth_law.falsifier: ratio never drops below 1 with depth — then episodic capital NEVER pays on these worlds and the ceiling hardens to a law
